name: Hannaneh Hajishirzi

affiliations.role: Senior Director, co-lead of OLMo and Tulu
Professor, Paul G. Allen School of Computer Science & Engineering

bio: Hannaneh Hajishirzi is a professor at the University of Washington's Allen School and a senior director at Ai2. Hajishirzi works on natural language processing and co-leads Ai2's OLMo open language model effort and the Tulu post-training project, and co-authored the Self-Instruct paper.
known_for: Co-leading the fully open OLMo language models at Ai2
Tulu open post-training and reasoning recipes
Co-PI on NSF and NVIDIA funded open AI infrastructure
